result.title: Train An Imaginative Agent
result.summary: A seemingly reasonable push in Sokoban can make the puzzle unsolvable. To avoid such mistakes, an agent has to anticipate the consequences of its actions before execution, especially when feedback from the real environment is sparse or actions are irreversible. We introduce Agentic Imagination (Agima), a training framework that trains an agent to imagine before acting, i.e. to be imaginative. Agima trains a single omni model to propose actions, generate images of their outcomes, and then reason over these imagined futures to decide what to execute in the real environment. Rather than committing to a single plan, the agent can simulate a sequence of actions, explore alternatives, and compare possible futures. We first use supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to unify policy and world modeling within a single omni model. This enables the agent to predict future outcomes and perform basic forms of imagination, such as forward thinking and counterfactual branching. We then use agentic reinforcement learning (RL) to teach the agent to reason with its imagined futures and use them effectively for planning. Across four environments spanning Maze2D, Sokoban, Pacman, and PushT, Agima generalizes to harder settings unseen during training. Trained with SFT alone on two-box Sokoban, Agima solves 40% of four-box puzzles while seeing the real board only once every five moves, compared with an action-only planner that only solves 2%. After RL, new behaviors emerge in how Agima uses its imagination: it learns a new unified format that was unseen during the SFT stage, learns to conduct forward thinking only when necessary, and branches more frequently at critical decision points. An agent that can picture where its actions lead can learn when and where to look ahead, that is, to plan. Project page: https://agima.net/.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Agima 训练框架：先用 SFT 让单一 omni 模型同时承担策略与世界模型，生成动作结果的未来图像，再用 agentic RL 教它基于想象出的未来做推理与规划，在 Maze2D、Sokoban、Pacman、PushT 上验证并泛化到更难设置。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接涉及推理期内部视觉状态的生成与使用：以想象出的未来图像作为推理素材并按需前瞻、在关键点分支，可供核查 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的触发条件与成本、动态计算及证据筛选机制；与 latent 推理的差别在于其状态为显式图像，可作对照。
